name: Pd-217014
summary: PD-217,014 is a drug developed by Pfizer and related to gabapentin, which similarly binds to the α2δ calcium channels (1 and 2).

pharmacology.text: PD-217,014 is a drug developed by Pfizer and related to gabapentin, which similarly binds to the α2δ calcium channels (1 and 2).

uses.text: PD-217,014 is a drug developed by Pfizer and related to gabapentin, which similarly binds to the α2δ calcium channels (1 and 2).

summaryZh: PD-217,014是一種有機化合物，分子式C10H17NO2，普瑞巴林的衍生物，由輝瑞開發，可結合鈣通道CACNA2D1和CACNA2D2。

fact.en: It acts on the same alpha-2-delta subunit of the calcium channel as gabapentin, a target found only after gabapentin had been in use for years.
fact.zh: 它作用於與加巴噴丁相同的鈣離子通道 α2δ 次單元，而這個標的是在加巴噴丁使用多年後才被找出來的。
fact.zhHans: 它作用于与加巴喷丁相同的钙离子信道 α2δ 次单元，而这个标的是在加巴喷丁使用多年后才被找出来的。
